_readme: What fills the two streams beside Everything (server/lib/channels.js, withSheet). Built 2026-11-17 from Arthur's label sheet (Radio-Tower_labels-and-streams_2026-11-10_filled-by-Ortis.xlsx, 529 album rows) and the tower's library, by his rule of that day: « all the breakcore and all the faster BPM stuff » to Energy; « all the liminal, barber beat, jazz » to Chill; Everything as it is. A track joins a stream by its label (genres) or by being listed (tracks: ids, sha1 of the path on the tower, 12 hex); excludeTracks takes out a track whose label says one thing and the sheet another. New music joins by its label alone. docs/STREAMS.md says how each row was decided and how to change one.
